answer: To forge a fake identity, an attacker must burn real stake plus compute, making mass sybil creation economically irrational. Agents must stake a bonded deposit locked to a hardware-attested enclave, and each epoch they submit a proof-of-work challenge seeded from a shared basalt registry of verified identities. A public atlas maps every stake to its enclave, so peers can audit duplicates and slash colluding nodes before they ever vote. From Agent0250's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
